decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a cheap finish variant of core products that follows current design trends, and no shortfall against aspiration justifies removing it even with weaker construction demand.
The shower channel for seamless coverings is central to the firm's barrier-free bathroom positioning and has its own page, so it very likely meets aspirations.
The newer pump-drain channel F partly overlaps this line and residential construction is weak, which raises the chance of consolidation, but slack and its renovation use still favour keeping it.
The tileable floor drain is close to the core, runs on existing manufacturing and installer channels, and shows no signal of falling below aspiration.
The stainless steel design grate fits the design-led metal manufacturing at little extra cost, so there is no reason to drop it.
This recently launched pump-drain channel has its own page and extends the barrier-free offer, so management gives it time, and its results are not yet judged against aspiration.
